requirement.statement: The system SHALL use the canonical ctrl-flow and AI workflow product naming families across packages, TypeScript APIs, XNL roots, docs, examples, behavior records and validation rules.

case.given: The public control-flow products are documented or loaded
case.when: The product names, package names, root tags or URI schemes are inspected

case.given: The public AI workflow products are documented or loaded
case.when: The product names, package names or root tags are inspected
case.then: The system SHALL expose `AICtrlWorkflow` / `ai-ctrl-workflow` and `AIDataWorkflow` / `ai-data-workflow`, with `AIWorkflow` / `ai-workflow` reserved for shared umbrella surfaces

case.given: The data-flow substrate products are documented or loaded
case.when: The product names, package names or root tags are inspected
case.then: The system SHALL keep `EagerDataFlow` / `eager-data-flow` and `AIDataWorkflow` / `ai-data-workflow` unchanged

requirement.statement: The system SHALL remove old public control-flow and AI-agent workflow names from the current authoring surface instead of keeping them as long-term aliases.

case.given: A current authoring bundle uses an obsolete root such as `InstantFlow`, `WorkFlow`, `BizProcess` or `AIAgentWorkflow`
case.when: The flow DSL checker or loader validates the bundle
case.then: The system SHALL reject it in current authoring mode and direct users to the canonical root names

case.given: The workspace packages and imports are inspected after migration
case.when: Package names and dependency names are listed
case.then: The old package names `instant-flow-*`, `work-flow-*`, `biz-process-*` and `ai-agent-workflow-*` SHALL NOT remain as public workspace packages

case.given: Temporary rename shims were used during implementation
case.when: The track is ready to complete
case.then: Those shims SHALL be removed or made non-public before the track is marked complete

requirement.statement: The system SHALL update current-truth documentation, examples, behavior records and active/pending Codument artifacts to the canonical naming family.

case.given: Users read flow-dsl docs or example bundles
case.when: They look for the product matrix, root tags or package names
case.then: The docs and examples SHALL present only the canonical names for current products

case.given: Future implementation reads active or pending Codument assets
case.when: Those assets describe flow product names or AI workflow product names
case.then: They SHALL use the canonical names unless explicitly describing historical migration context

case.given: The Eidolon native workflow boundary track is used after this rename
case.when: It references the AI control workflow product
